{{Quote|Though it was not part of the Rebel Alliance, Dornea has its own heroes from the fight against the Empire.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]]|<ref name="Before the Storm">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>}}
'''Dornea''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Dornean/Legends|Dornean]] species. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GSWU" /> was located in the [[Dornean system]] of the [[Dominus sector/Legends|Dominus sector]], which bordered the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]] out on [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Dornean Navy successfully defended Dornea's independence throughout the reign of Palpatine, against Imperial forces several times as large.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="Before the Storm" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Dornea [[Dornea's war against the Empire|defended]] itself with the [[Dornean Navy]] and resisted successfully against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial forces]], though it did not join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="GSWU" />

Having been heavily damaged in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Braha'tok|lead ship]] of the Dornean-made [[Braha'tok-class gunship/Legends|''Braha'tok''-class]] was later transported to the planet to serve as a war museum.<ref name="DB" />
